description: Integrated Context Analysis of shocks and food security: Pakistan is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by WFP - World Food Programme. The ICA is a process of consultations supported by mapped-out data that produces a strategic plan describing where different combinations of programme themes are appropriate to achieve goals of reducing food insecurity and climate related shock risk. Coverage: Pakistan. The portal files it under the publisher WFP - World Food Programme. Its tags are geodata, hazards and risk. It offers 23 resource(s) in PDF, PNG, SHP. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODC-ODbL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
